text_block_list.text: The new year. As I was relaxing in the quiet trainer's office—
(SLIDE—pitter-patter)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: T-Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: What should I do..., I... I...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry... I don't think I can go on anymore...
choice_data_list: W-What on earth happened!?
W-What on earth happened!?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Why did I...?
Even though I knew I shouldn't have...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Unconsciously, I couldn't stop...
I... I...—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I ate way too much mochi... and gained weight...

"I panicked for a moment at her unusual intensity, but it turned out to be nothing serious.
She had simply eaten too much mochi."
However, Cheval Grand couldn't bring herself to view it as "just" anything—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I... tend to gain weight easily...
I thought I had to be careful, but...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Mochi... is just so... delicious...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ah, b-but that's not all...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Actually, Big Sister, Vivlos, and I got into an argument over whether mochi is better sweet or savory—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"De-finitely sweet ones!
I love both kinako mochi and anko mochi♡"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Oshiruko sounds lovely too.
Grilling the mochi on a wire rack until it's nicely browned.
But what I simply cannot compromise on is—

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: When it comes to bean paste, it's chunky! Chunky bean paste all the way♡

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
B-But I prefer smooth bean paste over chunky...
And for mochi... I like seaweed salt...—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I-It's really good, seaweed and salt...
With butter on top, and...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"So juicy... and salty...
I could eat that forever—"
(Grrrrrr~~~~)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
N-No, that's not it, this is...!
Talking about it just brought back memories...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...So, um... uuuuugh—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
So... I'm really no good, are I...?
It was the same when I was talking to my sisters...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Talking about it made me want to eat some... and once I started, I couldn't stop...
choice_data_list: So that's why you overate?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Ugh... Yes...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"It's such an important year for an Umamusume, entering the Classic stage...
And yet, I'm really just..."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: How pathetic of me...
choice_data_list: Now, now.

text_block_list.text:
To anyone listening, it was a heartwarming New Year's anecdote,
but it seemed she was genuinely feeling down about it.
choice_data_list: Once you get moving, you'll be back to normal in no time.

text_block_list.text: I've prepared a rigorous training menu to tackle graded stakes once the break is over.

Considering that, a gain of a few kilograms during time off
is practically just a margin of error.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
A-Are you sure it's okay?
Like, I don't need to hurry up and go on a diet or—
choice_data_list: Then want to go for a walk to get some light exercise?
If anything, now I'm craving seaweed salt mochi too.
If anything, I think I want to eat some seaweed salt mochi too.
Let's do a New Year's calligraphy of self-discipline instead!

text_block_list.text:
A-Are you sure it's okay?
Like, I don't need to hurry up and go on a diet or—

Let's do a New Year's calligraphy of self-discipline instead!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
P-Please... help me train...!
I have to work off... what I ate...!

I only said it to comfort her,
but it seemed the earnest Cheval Grand took it as a serious proposal.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
W-Well, let's get right to it...
Um... Trainer,
I'll be in your care.

...Cheval Grand is motivated.
Considering our difference in stamina,
I prepare a bicycle to ride alongside her—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ah... This feels so nice...
It's quiet, and there's no wind—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, no, no. This was supposed to be exercise, right!
I have to put more energy into walking...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Yeah... My body's feeling all warm and toasty...

"We've walked quite a long way,
but Cheval Grand shows no signs of turning back."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Still, I need more... more fighting spirit...
choice_data_list: (!! Her speed increased—!)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: More... more, more, more... ngh!
More power surged into the legs pedaling the bicycle. My thighs were already burning and pumped to the limit—!
And so, after embarking on such a stoic walk, I ended up quite far away—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm so sorry...!
I kind of got carried away—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
B-But... we walked so much,
I'm sure it was great exercise—
(Grrrrrr~~~~)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek, a-after all that walking...!
M-My tummy is just...
choice_data_list: But I'm getting hungry too
Still, I'm hungry too.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...You're right...
Me too...
Moderation is key in all things. So, the two of them went off together to find a nearby place to eat.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Huh, r-really?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm glad.
I've never known anyone else to do that..."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Trainer is... hehe...
choice_data_list: Alright, let's get ready right away!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Um... Err, starting right now...?

Cheval Grand rarely talks about herself,
so now that she's shared her favorite food,
there's no reason not to give it a try.

Mochi, dried seaweed, salt, and butter are easy to come by.
Using the toaster, it should be a breeze to prepare them right here in the Trainer's Office—!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Wah, Trainer's... really fired up...
W-Were you that hungry...?
Getting ready to head out together—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I-I'm so sorry... You bought me... so much stuff...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Bean paste, cheese, and even daikon radish... And this is... white dashi...?
choice_data_list: Now let the Mochi Festival begin!
Now the Mochi Festival can begin!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I-I'm sorry for laughing... ngh.
It's just...—pfft... a "festival"... really?
And so, I was able to see Cheval Grand laughing innocently like a child for once.

Resetting her mindset through kakizome should keep her from feeling too down.
Now, let's prepare the ink and inkstone—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Th-This is hard...
My handwriting is getting smaller and smaller...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Writing this... is this okay...?
Sh-Should I write more carefully...?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I... I-I'm, d-done... whew.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Um, I'll read it now...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: "I am"—
choice_data_list: (......What's the subject here?!)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"‘During the crucial New Year of my Classic Year,
I ate way too much mochi.’"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: "I deeply reflect on this so that it will never happen again"...—
choice_data_list: I-I'm fine now, really...!

text_block_list.text:
She must have regretted it deeply, because instead of New Year's calligraphy,
she ended up writing a letter of apology!

I hurriedly calmed Cheval Grand down
and took her out for a light jog—
